endorsements.name: Jake Lishman
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-1403
endorsements.description: Qiskit SDK 0.45.0 through 1.2.4 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service using a maliciously crafted QPY file containing a malformed symengine serialization stream which can cause a segfault within the symengine library.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: HIGH (CVSS 3.1, 8.6)

povs-taxonomy.explanation: The CVE endorsement credits this individual with a reviewed vulnerability finding.

endorsements.name: Jake Lishman
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-2000
endorsements.description: A maliciously crafted QPY file can potential execute arbitrary-code embedded in the payload without privilege escalation when deserialising QPY formats < 13. A python process calling Qiskit 0.18.0 through 1.4.1's `qiskit.qpy.load()` function could potentially execute any arbitrary Python code embedded in the correct place in the binary file as part of specially constructed payload.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: CRITICAL (CVSS 3.1, 9.8)
